mentions.name: Fables and Friends
mentions.description: A website that helps people find tabletop RPG (TTRPG) games suited to them and provides a suite of tools for both GMs and players. Players can showcase characters they are playing or have played, and GMs can manage campaigns with scheduling and notes. It is designed to be system-agnostic rather than D&D-specific and is still in development.
mentions.audience: TTRPG players and game masters looking for suitable games and campaign tools
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm building a site that allows people to find TTRPG games that are suited to them AND includes a suite of tools for both GMs and players in said games.
